mapper.insert: INSERT INTO region_situation_assessment (public_id, region_id, assessment_time, situation_level, active_event_count, affected_population, trapped_population, evacuated_population, vulnerable_population, rule_set_id, rule_version, source_type, input_snapshot, warnings, created_by_client_id) VALUES (#{publicId}, #{regionId}, #{assessmentTime}, #{situationLevel}, #{activeEventCount}, #{affectedPopulation}, #{trappedPopulation}, #{evacuatedPopulation}, #{vulnerablePopulation}, #{ruleSetId}, #{ruleVersion}, #{sourceType}, CAST(#{inputSnapshot} AS JSON), CAST(#{warnings} AS JSON), #{createdByClientId})

INSERT INTO region_situation_assessment_event (assessment_id, event_id, observation_id, event_level, duration_hours, matched_rule_codes) VALUES (#{assessmentId}, #{eventId}, #{observationId}, #{eventLevel}, #{durationHours}, CAST(#{matchedRuleCodes} AS JSON))
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM region_situation_assessment a WHERE

SELECT a.id, a.public_id, r.region_code, r.region_name, a.assessment_time, a.situation_level, a.active_event_count, a.affected_population, a.trapped_population, a.evacuated_population, a.vulnerable_population, COALESCE((SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(e.public_id) FROM region_situation_assessment_event ae JOIN disaster_event e ON e.id = ae.event_id WHERE ae.assessment_id = a.id), JSON_ARRAY()) AS event_ids, a.rule_version, a.warnings FROM region_situation_assessment a JOIN region r ON r.id = a.region_id WHERE ORDER BY a.assessment_time DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{query.size} OFFSET #{query.offset}
